description: Provide authentic, deterministic astrological framework guidance for any life question (e.g. career shift, relationship milestones, financial timing, health/somatic wellness, relocation). Corresponds to the /ask slash command in Discord, Telegram, and Google Chat. Explains which astrological houses, ruling planetary significators (Karakas), and timing triggers govern the user's inquiry. If birth details are included in the question or parameters, also computes the native's actual natal placements and active Vimshottari Dasha.

question.title: Question
